Package com.kerosene.kfe.adapters.out.rail.custody

Class ConfigurableCustodyGateway

java.lang.Object
com.kerosene.kfe.adapters.out.rail.custody.ConfigurableCustodyGateway
All Implemented Interfaces:
CustodyGateway, LightningInvoiceGateway, LightningPaymentGateway
@Component("kfeConfigurableCustodyGateway") @ConditionalOnProperty(prefix="custody", name="enabled", havingValue="true", matchIfMissing=true) public class ConfigurableCustodyGateway extends Object implements CustodyGateway
Adapts a configurable custody-provider JSON API to the KFE custody contract. The adapter uses mock mode or missing credentials to make itself non-live, and refuses provider operations rather than silently simulating them.

    • ConfigurableCustodyGateway

      public ConfigurableCustodyGateway(@Value("${custody.provider-name:BCX}") String providerName, @Value("${custody.base-url:}") String baseUrl, @Value("${custody.api-key:}") String apiKey, @Value("${custody.mock-mode:false}") boolean mockMode, @Value("${custody.onchain-address-path:/api/v1/onchain/address}") String onchainAddressPath, @Value("${custody.lightning-invoice-path:/api/v1/lightning/invoice}") String lightningInvoicePath, @Value("${custody.lightning-invoice-status-path:/api/v1/lightning/invoice/status}") String lightningInvoiceStatusPath, @Value("${custody.lightning-invoice-cancel-path:/api/v1/lightning/invoice/cancel}") String lightningInvoiceCancelPath, @Value("${custody.onchain-send-path:/api/v1/onchain/send}") String onchainSendPath, @Value("${custody.lightning-pay-path:/api/v1/lightning/pay}") String lightningPayPath, @Qualifier("custodyRestTemplate") org.springframework.web.client.RestTemplate restTemplate, com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper objectMapper)
      Builds the adapter from provider settings, routes, HTTP client, and JSON codec.
      Parameters:
      providerName - stable provider label
      baseUrl - provider server base URL
      apiKey - bearer credential
      mockMode - whether live requests must be disabled
      onchainAddressPath - address-generation endpoint
      lightningInvoicePath - Lightning invoice-creation endpoint
      lightningInvoiceStatusPath - invoice-status endpoint
      lightningInvoiceCancelPath - invoice-cancellation endpoint
      onchainSendPath - on-chain payment endpoint
      lightningPayPath - Lightning payment endpoint
      restTemplate - configured custody HTTP client
      objectMapper - JSON serializer and parser
